name: Pro API Playground
description: Postman-style try-it console driven by an OpenAPI 3.x document: virtualised, searchable endpoint tree; bearer / basic / API-key auth; path, query and header params; CodeMirror JSON body with Ajv schema validation; timed fetch with cancel; pretty / raw / headers response views; cURL, JavaScript and Python snippets; persisted request history; resizable panes.

examples.title: Northwind CRM API (90+ endpoints, mocked network)

props.name: spec
props.description: OpenAPI 3.0 / 3.1 document (parsed JSON or JSON string); local $refs are resolved

props.name: fetcher
props.description: Replace window.fetch (proxy through your backend, add tracing, mock)

props.name: defaultServer
props.description: Server URL override (defaults to first servers entry)

props.name: historyStorageKey
props.description: Persist request history to localStorage under this key (secrets are never stored in snippets)

props.name: onResponse
props.description: Fires after each completed request with status, timing and body

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Existing React Query client (private one created otherwise)

usage: Requests are sent from the browser, so the target API must allow CORS; pass a fetcher to route through a proxy.
